description.p: P2PDesk is a serverless remote desktop: the controller finds the target by its libp2p peer id on a public DHT and connects directly. No account, no self-hosted rendezvous server, and session data does not traverse a relay.

ul.li: Direct peer-to-peer connection with the stock RustDesk handshake on top.
VP8 / VP9 / AV1 software codecs and H.264 / H.265 hardware codecs.
Self-hosting is optional: a custom DHT bootstrap node replaces the public network.

description.p: This is a fork of RustDesk 1.4.9 (AGPL-3.0) that replaces the hbbs/hbbr servers with a go-libp2p module. The Linux packaging is inherited from upstream and is not regularly tested by the maintainer.
